title: 🎟️ Press invite for review 🎥 by me 📸 by Ben Arons #theatre #plays #ny...
transcript: this is probably the most delightfully weird show playing in New York City right now and it's being produced by one of my favorite theater companies Ars Nova this is the theater company where shows like Great Comet KPOP and Oratorio for Living Things played and this season they have the Beastiary which is like modeled after a medieval pageant play and it tells a post-apocalyptic story about the last 8 people on earth living amongst a bunch of mythical beasts this hyperpresentational pageant style allows them to showcase their super distinct aesthetic through puppetry, sets, costumes, and a live musical soundscape that prominently features a theramin and if you don't know what a theramin sounds like Google it because it perfectly encapsulates the vibe of this show The play is mostly really funny and entertaining but this style while in the format that they chose to use can sometimes feel a bit slow and disjointed but there's also this hilarious old timey narration think like Pyramus and Thysbe in Midsummer Night’s Dream and that also goes a long way to help set the scene and bring us along for the ride buteven during the scenes that I found a little bit more difficult to latch onto I was still fully mesmerized by just the bizarre fever-dreamlike quality to the whole performance and even just impressed at how on the Rocks Theater Company the creators of the show were able to execute their vision with such a specific artistic sensibility so if you think this might be your thing I definitely recommend checking out the Beastiary before it closes on November 9th
